column1: # BOGA path-trigger registry — machine-readable form of "which gate for what
# you changed" (the human tables live in AGENTS.md and
# docs/specs/02-quality-and-test-gates.md; keep all three in sync in the same
# change — docs-check validates that the lanes cited here exist).
# Consumed by `./boga test for [--diff <range>] [paths...]` and `./boga pr check`.
#   pattern:  glob over repo-relative paths. `**` matches across `/`,
#             and/or lane names from scripts/lanes.tsv. A `-name` entry REMOVES
#             that requirement for the paths this row matches (a narrower row
#             carving an exception out of a broader one); it never affects
#             other paths in the same change.
#   rule:     short human name — this is what a ⛔ N/A justification cites.
#   A changed path may match many rows; its requirement is the UNION of them
#   minus their removals, and the change's requirement is the union over paths.
# UI tiering (spec 02, "Which gate for what you changed"): a screen/component
# change runs `frontend-ui` — every simulator lane that needs no backend. The
# run only for their own screens (rows below) and for the src/sync, src/auth,
# src/groups, and migration rows; the full sweep (`boga sweep`, run before iOS
# builds and on large PRs — test-for recommends it) runs everything.
